verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe plain-language feature/bug requests being planned and implemented across multiple files with verification (claude-code-docs-2/28, docs-20), and GitHub confirms this workflow in terminal/IDE/GitHub contexts. However, independent hands-on reports describe real reliability caveats for multi-file edits (e.g., replace_all corrupting a constant definition, degraded output requiring heavy CLAUDE.md guardrails, and a user reporting a 100% failure rate on their tasks), so the story is delivered but with meaningful quality caveats rather than flawless execution. Missing for 10: independent benchmark or reproducible case studies showing consistent multi-file correctness, and resolution of the self-verification failure reports.
